_doc: Lamps frozen in M1's motion clips. A generative video model does not know a flame is attached to a wick: it treats fire as texture and lets it drift. The director found it on 2026-09-23 - in 01-03 the diya at bottom-left has flames that slide along the rim and detach, one hovering clear of the rim around 5.2 s, while the lamp and the bowl beneath it stay put. Fainter signs of the same around the lamp at frame-left in 01-07 and 01-08.
_fix: Freeze, do not re-render. The approved STILL is composited back over the clip, masked to the lamp alone, with a soft edge. Everything the shot is about keeps moving; the fire stops being animated, which is what the graph asked for - 'a lamp flame drifting' never meant a lamp flame travelling. Re-rendering would be dearer and would roll the dice again on identity.
_why_regions_are_declared: Four automatic detectors were tried and each one would have frozen something it should not. Bright compact blobs in the STILL: 431 'lamps' in 01-03, most of them lattice light on stone. Bright compact blobs that MOVE in the clip: eleven in 01-03, seven of them gold ornament on ministers who are turning their heads. Adding the director's own test - 'the lamp and bowl are steady; only the fire moves' - cut it to seven, three still on a minister's turban and shoulder. Bright pixels that CHANGED between still and clip: 191 blobs, a tenth of the frame, because the model redraws every lit surface slightly. So the detector proposes and this file disposes: each region below is a box a person looked at. What gets frozen inside it is still decided by the pixels - the bright blobs there, grown and feathered - so a box is a permission, not a brush.
_coordinates: Read off a coordinate grid drawn on the clip's own first frame, at full 1080x1920. An earlier box placed by eye off a scaled crop put 01-07's mask on the king's crown.
_verified_by: tools/flameverify.py - the director's test: the bright-pixel centroid inside the mask stays within 1 px across the shot, and nothing bright comes loose within 60 px of it.

_swept: Every animated shot was swept for bright compact blobs that move. The sweep proposed candidates in ten of fourteen; five turned out to be lamps and are frozen here. The other five - 01-04, 01-06, 01-09, 01-11 and 01-13 - are the KING'S GOLD: crown ornaments, necklaces, an armband, a ring, a belt. It moves because he moves, which is the shot working, and freezing any of it would freeze part of him. 01-05's single candidate is his belt too. 01-08, 01-10, 01-12 and 01-14 proposed nothing.

_edges: Every frozen shot was looked at across two widely separated frames. No freeze edge shows on any of them, so none needed re-rendering.

_removed.01-03: Not frozen any more, and not frozen at all: the director had the foreground diya REMOVED from the still instead. Codex supplied a no-lamp 01-03 on 2026-09-23 and the clip was re-rendered from it, so there is no flame in that shot to come loose. A lamp taken out of the frame beats a lamp pasted back over it.

_sweep: All thirteen animated shots were gone through by eye, top half and bottom half of each approved still. Of the director's 30 candidate positions, 12 are lamps and 18 are not - lattice light, gold throne finial, a fold of white dhoti, the king's armband, the sage's hair and shoulder, and light patches on the marble. Twenty lamps the candidate list did not name were found, most of them tall standing lamps in the background.
_guard: Every declared region is MEASURED for motion before anything is pasted. A box drawn by eye off a still can land on something that is supposed to move - a hand, an arm, cloth - and freezing that is worse than the flame it was meant to stop. A region with real motion in it is refused by name.
_large_and_close: Three lamps are large and close enough to camera that the director's preference is REMOVAL from the still rather than a freeze: 01-02's two tall standing lamps at the sides of the aisle, and 01-10's diya at bottom-right. They are frozen here so this cut is clean; removal needs Codex.
_superseded: 01-01's entry is dropped: the shot was cut from the film on 2026-09-23.
_widened: The first pass boxed the flames; the ring test then found the LAMPS still moving just outside them - a column at (0,576) 139x597 beside 01-05's box, 47x191 beside 01-07's, 138x184 beside 01-14's. A lamp is not only its flame: the polished brass under it carries the same light and redraws with it. The boxes were widened to the lamp.
_found_by_watching: Three lamps the stills sweep missed, found only by watching the film: 01-09 has a flame at (725-880, 870-1105) and another at (550-790, 1190-1430), 01-11 one at (650-850, 1270-1425), 01-12 one at (740-905, 1090-1285). They were missed for the same reason in every case - in the APPROVED STILL the figure stands in front of them, and in the clip he moves and reveals them. A sweep of the stills cannot see a lamp the still hides. This is the whole argument for the director's last step: the measurement is the check, the eyes are the test.
_guard_v2: The motion guard first measured ALL motion in a box and refused to freeze the flames themselves - 01-09's flame peaks at 19.35 in the strip where it moves most, which is precisely the defect. It now looks away from the fire: pixels warm and bright in the approved still, and their halo, are excluded, so what it measures is whether anything ELSE in the box moves. A hand crossing a lamp still trips it; the lamp alone does not.
_guard_v3: The guard looked for fire only in the approved STILL, and the worst flame in the film is not in the still at all: 01-09's is a large flame the motion model invented, floating free in mid-air against the steps with nothing holding it, changing shape completely across the shot. The guard could not see it as fire, read its thrashing as 'something else is moving here', and refused to freeze the one region that most needed it - so the flame survived two rounds and the director spotted it in the delivered cut. Fire is now anything warm and bright in the still OR anywhere in the clip. What the guard is actually looking for is a PERFORMER, and a performer is not a clipping warm core. Two earlier refusals were the same mistake: 01-02's small flame and 01-05's full-width lamp both measure 0.0 under the corrected guard and are frozen.
